meta.title: Try Stopping.
meta.author: Eladamri
meta.description: The soundtrack of Try Stopping. by Eladamri (2023-04-09). 32K executable music that placed 6th in the executable music competition at Revision 2023. (The WaveSabre test suite has an earlier project file of it; that test song is eladamri.song.json.) 130 BPM, 3:11, 9 tracks, 2129 notes. Instruments: 2 Falcon (FM synth), 4 Slaughter (subtractive synth), 3 Specimen (GSM sampler). Effects: 1 Scissor, 2 Leveller, 2 Echo, 1 Smasher, 1 Chamber. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the WaveSabre song was read from the running executable's memory (tools/ws-extract, Wine), converted by `synth-convert ws` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64, effects 65-73) and imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the bit-exact WaveSabre port it differs by -0.03 dB loudness and at most 0.83 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz (16 kHz up to 3 dB brighter, a known difference of the unified engine). Track names are derived here from each track's instrument and notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
